title: An access key without an issued route
body: The pencil route bends around a closed road, then resumes beyond it. A brass key has no door number; a coffee stain takes the place of the signature.
rival_reading: A farm crew could leave a site key and redirect deliveries around a closed road; the missing signature may be a routine handoff failure, not a failed cordon.
gloss: A key without an assigned door lies with a route that skirts a closure and resumes beyond it.

title: The container pair with a missing label
body: Leaf grit has dried in the bucket. A clean bottle is wedged under its handle, and a torn supply label still reads “rinse before return.”
rival_reading: After an evacuation or cleanup, staff could rinse and return ordinary containers; debris and a missing label do not establish an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A bucket with field debris and a rinsed bottle remain with a partly torn care label.
